settings.name: shippo_api_key
settings.description: Shippo API key (a test key to try it, a production key for real rates). Encrypted at rest and never sent to a browser

settings.name: shippo_services
settings.description: The services offered to customers, as carrier:service pairs separated by commas, using Shippo's provider and service level token (USPS:usps_priority). Only carriers on your Shippo account return rates

settings.name: shippo_other_services
settings.description: Whether to also offer any other service Shippo returns (other carriers, and services not in the list above)

settings.name: shippo_from_email
settings.description: An email address for the Ship From address. Shippo will not make a label without one, and carriers may send tracking to it

settings.name: shippo_residential
settings.description: Whether orders are priced as going to a home, which carriers charge a surcharge for. Turn off if you mostly ship to businesses

settings.name: shippo_cache_minutes
settings.description: How long a price from Shippo is reused for the same route, weight and size. Keeps checkout fast and keeps the number of rate requests (which Shippo can charge for) down
